svg.title: An overview of the main nodes of Autoware in the default setup of autoware_launch. Sensing and Map feed Localization and Perception. Planning uses the kinematic state, the objects, the traffic signals, the obstacle point cloud, the occupancy grid, and the vector map to make the trajectory. Control follows the trajectory with the kinematic state and sends commands to the vehicle interface, optionally through the raw vehicle command converter. The MRM handler of System sends emergency commands to the vehicle command gate. The AD API runs beside them.
